result.title: I Didn’t Know AI Could Do THIS
result.description:
I’ve never seen anyone use AI for this before 🤯

People are taking screenshots of Google Maps, drawing a path on it, and having AI generate incredibly realistic video following that exact route.

The results are super cool and honestly really impressive. 

If you're a short filmmaker who needs an establishing shot but don’t have the budget for a drone, this could be great option for you.

#AI #AInews #genAI #contentcreator

result.title: YouTube Is Cracking Down On AI Slop
result.description:
BIG NEWS: YouTube is finally cracking down on AI generated videos.

Until now, creators had to manually check a box in the back end to disclose if their content was made with AI, but let’s be real…most people just didn’t do it. 

Now, YouTube is moving the AI disclosure label to a much more prominent position and introducing AUTOMATIC AI detection.

This is super interesting to me because a lot of times my YouTube video intros are made with AI, but the entire rest of the video doesn't. So I wonder if my videos get flagged automatically.

What do you guys think of this new update?

#YouTube #AI #AInews #ContentCreator #genAI

result.title: How To Check If A Data Center Is Near You
result.description:
Is an AI data center coming to your neighborhood?

SAVE this post so you don't forget to check your zip code later…

Erin Brockovich (the same one who had a movie made about her) just launched a new crowdsourced map to help communities track exactly where AI data centers are popping up.

Whether you’re worried about the environmental impact, power grid, or just curious about what's being built down the street, this is a pretty cool and useful tool.
Just go to brockovichdatacenter.com to check it out. 

#AI #Ainews #DataCenters

result.title: AI Transformed My Website In A Few Hours
result.description:
Head to this link https://app.mindstudio.ai/signup?plan=mattwolfe for 90-days of free access to Remy and $25 in credits!

I wanted to see if AI could rebuild my website… and honestly the result kind of shocked me.

I used Remy from @MindStudio_ai to see if it could completely redesign my FutureTools.io site and it felt VERY different from the other AI coding tools I’ve tried lately.

Instead of just dumping code onto the screen, it actually guided me through the product thinking. And then it built the entire thing with a BUNCH of smart features like an email login, an admin dashboard to review submitted tools, an area to manage the agents that scan X, Google search, and a bunch of other news sources, and an AI tools Favorites page.

All of this was built in half a day and it was so easy because I just needed the 1 platform for everything, instead of having to go between multiple AI tools for each part. 

It’s honestly really exciting to think that anybody with a good idea can just launch real software products without needing a giant team now. The barrier of entry to building software products just got a lot lower. 

Let me know which version of the site you like better 👀
